body:
# Trial the world, tell the Tale!
Minecraft's essence is exploration and the sense of mystery. We explore, we mine, we craft, we build.

But then? We tell tales of all we did. We capture what we felt. I captured what we've seen.

![Trials & Tales Panorama](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2636b8e79623b61d16e11508e435fea56c5e12d.webp)

# Features
- Single prerendered panorama of two scenes (cherry biome & archeology hideout) for your main menu

# Not your cup of tea?
Feel free to check out [other panoramas](https://modrinth.com/user/Lumora) that I made for you!
